custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'lace-like' pattern. Real socks rarely have large open holes unless specifically designed as fashion items. Check if the pattern logic holds up under stretching at the heel, or if the holes distort unnaturally (melting). Verify if the heel shape implies a real foot inside or if it looks like an empty tube.
